steps.en: Start Loki, the Alloy agent and Grafana from the quick-start compose file
steps.zh: 用示例 compose 拉起 Loki、Alloy 和 Grafana

steps.en: Tell the agent which logs to tail and which few labels to stamp on them
steps.zh: 告诉采集器盯哪些日志、给它们打哪几个标签

steps.en: Receives pushed lines and groups those with identical labels into one stream
steps.zh: 接收推来的日志行，标签完全相同的归成一条流

steps.en: Compresses each stream into chunks in object storage, indexing only its labels
steps.zh: 把每条流压缩成块写进对象存储，只给标签建索引

steps.en: In Grafana, select streams by label, then filter lines like grep
steps.zh: 在 Grafana 里先按标签选流，再像 grep 一样过滤行

steps.en: Finds the matching chunks via the label index and scans them in parallel
steps.zh: 靠标签索引找到相关的块，并行扫描后返回结果

value.en: Every pod's logs stay searchable at object-storage prices, under the same labels as your Prometheus metrics
value.zh: 所有 Pod 的日志按对象存储的价钱留着可查，标签和 Prometheus 指标是同一套

sources: https://github.com/grafana/loki/blob/main/docs/sources/get-started/overview.md (agent adds labels and pushes over HTTP; chunks in object storage; label-only index)
